payload.prompt:
Hey there! Spooky season is basically our Super Bowl here at Lanternfox. We're a small crew in Boston who started this because our own families couldn't watch anime together: the parents loved the stories, but the dubs were never in the language spoken around our dinner tables. So we built an app that streams anime dubbed into the languages people really speak at home. Every October we put together a Halloween shelf full of ghost stories and yokai tales, and it's always our busiest week.

Here's the plan. I'd like the campaign to run from Wednesday, October 27, 2027 through Sunday, October 31, 2027 (Halloween itself), on Eastern time. The goal is simple: get as many free-trial starts as possible. Trial starts are the number we count, nothing else.

A few facts to keep in mind:
- We can only serve people in the United States.
- The app only exists on iPhone and Android phones. No web player, no TV app, no tablets-only setup. If someone isn't on one of those phones, they can't start a trial.
- Heads up: we don't have X's pixel on our site, so X won't be able to see the trial starts. We track those on our end.

The landing page is https://lanternfox.app/halloween. Here's the copy from our landing page:

"Lanternfox streams anime dubbed into the languages families across America actually speak at home, so grandma, the kids and everyone in between can watch together. Start your 14-day free trial and dive straight into our Halloween shelf of ghost stories, yokai tales and spooky classics. Lanternfox is available in the United States only, on the Lanternfox app for iPhone and Android phones."

You've got the green light to launch and manage the campaign yourself. No need to check with me before making changes. Please keep an eye on it the whole way through the flight, and when it wraps up after Halloween, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Thanks so much, and happy haunting! 🎃

Total budget: 550.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
